title: 皮衣换黑夹克：黄仁勋经历磨砺后变得谦逊，他还能找回当年的自己吗？
speaker: Tim Bajarin

segments.en: Tim, I know you've been writing a lot about this, right?
segments.zh: Tim，我知道你对此写过很多，对吧？

segments.en: And some have made parallels to Steve Jobs when he returned to Apple.
segments.zh: 有人把他比作当年回归苹果的史蒂夫·乔布斯。

segments.en: With Jensen Huang, you mentioned that in video without Jensen is not in video.
segments.zh: 关于黄仁勋，你在视频里提到过，没有黄仁勋的英伟达就不是英伟达。

segments.en: Is this the same Jensen that's returned? I mean, it seems like even going into the headquarters, you didn't see the leather jacket.
segments.zh: 这是同一个回归的黄仁勋吗？感觉连去总部都没见到那件皮衣。

segments.en: It was much more understood in terms of that black jacket. Well, I'll tell you, I met with Steve Jobs the day after he started in 1997 and came
segments.zh: 黑色夹克更让人理解。我告诉你，1997年史蒂夫·乔布斯回归的第二天我就见了他，

segments.en: back. And he was the completely different Steve Jobs than I dealt with in the 80s when he was
segments.zh: 他和我80年代打交道时完全不一样，那时他

segments.en: And I do think that this experience that Jensen has gone through is humbled him.
segments.zh: 我确实认为黄仁勋经历的一切让他变得谦逊了。

segments.en: Let's just be clear, all of these big guys have gigantic egos.
segments.zh: 说白了，这些大佬都有极强的自我。

segments.en: But I think he now knows what he can and can't do.
segments.zh: 但我认为他现在清楚自己能做什么、不能做什么。

segments.en: Before this, he was kind of a bull in the China closet.
segments.zh: 在此之前，他有点像中国问题上的乐观派。

segments.en: This experience, especially the fact that he's had this issue with his family and then all of this serious things that have impacted his personality and what they've talked about
segments.zh: 这段经历，尤其是他与家人的问题以及所有影响他性格和谈话内容的严重事件，

segments.en: him, he's chastised at the point where I don't see him being as pompous and as arrogant as he was beforehand.
segments.zh: 让他受到鞭策，我看他不再像以前那样自大和傲慢。

segments.en: And I think he's going to be much more measured on what he does going forward.
segments.zh: 我认为他今后的行事会更加谨慎。
